verdict.rationale: Pandoc's own GitHub repo points to a limited online demo and a WebAssembly-based online demo, so a one-off conversion can be done in the browser without installing anything. The only evidence is that single brief mention, and it calls the demo 'limited'. Missing for 10: documentation of the browser demo's supported formats and limits, confirmation that WebAssembly conversion runs fully client-side, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, a one-off conversion works in the browser with nothing installed

citations.quote: a limited online demo, and a WebAssembly-based online demo
